description: This Dart source file defines the AuthProvider class, which manages authentication state in a Flutter application. It handles loading sessions, login, and logout functionalities, interacts with external services for API calls and real-time communication, and manages tokens and user data persistence.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A class extending ChangeNotifier that manages user authentication state, including loading user sessions, handling login/logout processes, and setting up real-time communication.

methods.name: AuthProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor for AuthProvider, initializing with API and real-time service instances.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Factory constructor that initializes AuthProvider with API client and real-time service instances connected with token getter.

methods.name: _tokenGetter
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the current authentication token from local storage.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads existing user session from local storage, fetches user data if token exists, and connects real-time service.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, stores token, fetches user info, and establishes real-time connection in case of success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored token, resets user state, and disconnects real-time service.
